scope: Interface-only ROS 2 package retaining the original request and empty response. It does not contain Gazebo Classic plugins or dynamic_reconfigure.
reference_selection: Existing project Hector implementation reference; original lidar dependency did not pin its Hector version.
finite_request_adaptation: Nonfinite bias requests retain the prior state and increment rejected_bias_requests. The source empty response has no success field; callers must supply finite vectors or inspect imu_state.
